label: PF Backlog 413
title: Precheck: run CHANGED-SCOPED tests by default; full suite in CI/merge + real-idea dogfood at release
body: precheck.py always runs the entire ~831-test suite (~5-15 min) on every change, which is wasteful for small edits. Change: default = run tests for changed modules + direct dependents (fast); provide --full to run everything; CI + epic/merge gates run the full suite; the real-idea DOGFOOD lifecycle stays a separate release gate (unchanged). Keep final-audit (dry lifecycle) in precheck.

delivery.note: precheck scoping + auto-groom hang fix (committed on develop)
